cohort: The study included 94 women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia who received either prophylactic phenylephrine infusion or interventional ephedrine boluses for blood pressure control.
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion provided superior maternal hemodynamic stability and better tolerance during cesarean delivery compared to interventional ephedrine boluses, without significantly affecting neonatal acid-base status.
mod_finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion during cesarean delivery offers superior maternal hemodynamic stability and better tolerance compared to interventional ephedrine boluses, without detrimental effects on neonatal acid-base status.
